name: mog-canvas
description: Open, edit, save, and validate local XLSX workbooks in a real Mog spreadsheet canvas rendered as an MCP App inside Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Live Mog spreadsheet canvas for local XLSX workbooks.
interface.longDescription: Mog Canvas exposes an MCP server whose tools open authorized workbooks from a confined local root, render them in the real @mog-sdk/spreadsheet-app canvas via an MCP Apps UI resource, and save edits back to disk with revision checks, automatic backups, and headless validation. Workbook bytes travel only through MCP tools; engine assets are served from a loopback-only asset host.
capabilities: Open local XLSX workbooks in a live Mog canvas
Edit and save with revision-conflict protection
defaultPrompt: List the workbooks I can open
Open sample.xlsx in the Mog canvas
Save my workbook and validate it
